Citymaker.Recipe.Quarry.Description: A terraced pit with a haul road spiralling down the benches, stockpiles and plant — or a big flooded dig lake. Permanent terrain change.
Citymaker.Quarry.Name: Quarry
Citymaker.Quarry.subtype.Tooltip: Working pit, wet lake dig, or an old flooded / abandoned quarry.
Citymaker.Quarry.pitSize.Tooltip: How much of the space inside the rim the pit takes.
Citymaker.Quarry.pitShape.Tooltip: Follow the outline, an oval, or a rough organic face.
Citymaker.Quarry.levels.Tooltip: Number of steps down to the floor (fewer when the pit is too narrow).
Citymaker.Quarry.benchHeight.Tooltip: Drop of each step. Total depth = benches × bench height.
Citymaker.Quarry.benchWidth.Tooltip: Width of each ledge (the haul road runs on them).
Citymaker.Quarry.rimWidth.Tooltip: Untouched ground between the outline and the pit, where the yard sits.
Citymaker.Quarry.maxSlope.Tooltip: Steepest change allowed measured from the outline, so the pit always meets the original ground.
Citymaker.Quarry.water.Tooltip: Fills the pit with water. A permanent lake.
Citymaker.Quarry.waterFill.Tooltip: How far up the pit the water stands; always below the lowest dry bench so it never spills.
Citymaker.Quarry.warnings.Tooltip: A fence round the pit edge and danger signs.
Citymaker.Quarry.haulRoad.Tooltip: A ramp road from the gate spiralling down the benches to the floor.
Citymaker.Quarry.grade.Tooltip: Steepness of the ramp between benches.
Citymaker.Quarry.plant.Tooltip: Crusher and screens by the pit, a site office by the gate (and conveyors on a lake dig).
Citymaker.Quarry.lookout.Tooltip: A viewpoint with benches on the rim, with a footpath to the outline.
Citymaker.Quarry.pitPaint.Tooltip: Paints the exposed rock / sand texture over the pit and roads. Permanent.
Citymaker.Quarry.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
Citymaker.Quarry.scree.Tooltip: Fallen rocks per hectare at the foot of the bench walls.
Citymaker.Quarry.overgrowth.Tooltip: Trees and bushes taking over the rim (and the benches of old quarries).
Citymaker.Quarry.Issue.LakePermanent: The flooded pit is a permanent lake: removing the quarry keeps the basin and the water.
Citymaker.Quarry.Issue.NoRoomForPit: The area is too narrow for a pit inside the rim; only the yard is built.
Citymaker.Quarry.Issue.FewerBenches: Only {0} of {1} benches fit in this pit.
Citymaker.Quarry.Issue.NoWater: The pit is too shallow to hold water; it stays dry.
